name: Frozen Rain
description: Heavy neon rain stops in mid-air and the subject walks through the suspended drops. Beta.

wardrobe.man: a dark navy overshirt darkened by the rain, a black t-shirt and black trousers
wardrobe.woman: a dark navy jacket darkened by the rain, a black top and black trousers
wardrobe.person: a dark navy jacket darkened by the rain, a black top and black trousers

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. The {subject} from the reference images is the only person in it: keep {their} exact face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline and hairstyle, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. Take only the face and hair from the references; the clothing, background and lighting are all new. The {subject} stands in the middle of a narrow city street at night in heavy rain, facing the camera, soaked, wearing {wardrobe}, water running down the face and shoulders. Rain falls in dense silver streaks through the whole frame, the wet asphalt is a mirror of colored light, and soft out-of-focus bands of magenta and cyan neon glow from the shopfronts on both sides. Medium-wide shot at eye level, the full body in the center, rain visible in the foreground, midground and background. Cinematic night photography, neon practical lighting, deep blacks. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, neon reduced to soft abstract bands of light throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. In the first second the heavy rain stops in mid-air: every falling drop freezes in place as a large round glass bead, thousands of suspended drops hanging motionless through the whole street, each one catching the magenta and cyan neon light like a tiny lens. The {subject}, ALREADY facing the camera, takes a slow breath and looks around at the frozen drops, eyes flicking from one to another, then walks slowly toward the camera through the suspended rain, and every drop that touches {their} face, shoulders and chest bursts into a tiny glittering splash while the rest stay perfectly still. The camera trucks slowly sideways at eye level, and the frozen drops shift in parallax in the foreground, midground and background, proving they hang still in the air. Sound: the roar of rain cutting to sudden silence, then a soft high crystalline shimmer, slow footsteps on wet asphalt and the tiny pops of drops bursting. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, frozen time, sharp detail, stable picture.
